summary: Completed testing of PayLock Pro iteration 66 - Enhanced lock/unlock features. All 22 backend tests passed. Fixed 2 bugs: 1) lock_message was set to None on unlock (should be empty string), 2) renderModal function was missing in portal JS. Portal Lock History modal now works correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Portal login, dashboard, clients, client detail, lock history modal all working)

seed_data_creation: Test clients created and cleaned up during lock/unlock tests (TEST_LockClient_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 66 features verified working. Lock endpoint supports: reason (manual|overdue_payment|policy_violation|suspicious_activity|auto_lock), message, temporary, unlock_after_hours. Lock history stored in 'lock_audit_log' MongoDB collection. Portal renderModal function added for Lock History display.

bugs_fixed.issue: lock_message was set to None on unlock, causing Pydantic validation error (Client model expects str)
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed lock_message: None to lock_message: '' (empty string)

bugs_fixed.issue: renderModal function was missing but called by showLockHistory
bugs_fixed.fix: Added renderModal function to render generic modal from state.modal object

enhanced_lock_endpoint: ✓ Invalid lock reason is rejected with 422
unlock_endpoint: ✓ Unlock clears all lock fields correctly (is_locked, lock_reason, lock_message, auto_unlock_at, is_temporary_lock)
✓ Unlock creates audit entry in lock_history
lock_history_endpoint: ✓ Lock history includes reason and message
✓ Lock history returns 404 for nonexistent client
portal_files: ✓ Portal JS has enhanced toggleLock with reason support

portal_ui: ✓ Clients table loads and displays clients
✓ Client detail view shows Lock History button
✓ Lock History modal displays correctly with action, reason, message, time columns

unlock.audit_entry: Creates entry in lock_audit_log with action='unlock', reason='manual_unlock'

portal_lock_history.button: Lock History button on client detail page
portal_lock_history.modal: Displays table with ACTION, REASON, MESSAGE, TIME columns
